verification.specImpact: Planning-only cross-cutting corrections: C06/C12 executable contracts, compact specs/DAG, ROADMAP, GitHub execution navigation and Master conditional rules aligned. No product/runtime/browser implementation changed.

corrections: C02 separates runtime/build identity from schema/storage-format compatibility; ordinary build changes do not make an existing DB incompatible.
C03 keeps atomic persistence over the authoritative structures actually selected by C02 and does not mandate a duplicate latest structure.
Current V2 spec guidance no longer points at the retired WP-* execution graph.

C05/C06 define parity from the implemented public surface specs/tests rather than IndexedDB internals, preserve key Current/Detail observable behavior, and scope the final parity Unknown to the two product surfaces.
The second of C05/C06 to close owns the shared Current→Detail→Back regression so parallel execution cannot leave integration unverified.
C07 records its representative query corpus and day-sized workload parameters before deciding whether optimization is needed; no final trading formula or fixed horizon schema is implied.

C08 makes draft state non-executing, preserves the previous active config on failed activation, proves read-only safety on the exact pinned build without regex-only enforcement, uses deterministic single-runtime activation ordering, and keeps Scanner cadence independent from collection.
The current target architecture and SQL analytics direction were aligned to the compact post-KISS baseline, removing stale mandatory latest/fixed-horizon/immutable-version/anchored-scheduler design.

C09 makes runtime active/status authoritative over Viewer-local draft state, keeps result/error attribution tied to the producing execution, handles uncommon values truthfully and keeps Scanner UI isolated from provider/collector behavior.

C10 fixes one canonical stable Web Lock, fail-fast independent-tab acquisition, no weaker ownership fallback, diagnostic-only messaging/query surfaces, and release only after the old local runtime reaches its no-further-mutation teardown boundary.
D-040 and the multi-tab/target architecture docs were aligned so real-origin two-tab ownership is verified in C12 rather than as a stale early WP gate.
C11 fixes its deciding workload before measurement, verifies exact successful-cycle integrity, and includes O3 alongside O2/O4/O5 as an evidence-triggered branch with rerun requirements.

C12 is a no-overlap release transition: stop/settle old IndexedDB Recorder first, then prove real-origin ownership, start fresh SQL authority, exercise Current/Detail/Scanner, accept only after bounded verification, or explicitly rollback while preserving both data sets.
D-035 and current lifecycle/testing/target-architecture wording were aligned to remove stale fixed-horizon and pre-cutover-dual-run implications.
